title: Mica deposits of the southeastern Piedmont, Part 7, Hartwell district, Georgia and South Carolina; Part 8, Outlying deposits in South Carolina
citation: Griffitts, W.R., and Olson, J.C., 1952, Mica deposits of the southeastern Piedmont, Part 7, Hartwell district, Georgia and South Carolina; Part 8, Outlying deposits in South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Professional Paper 248-E, map scale 1:950,000.
notes:
USGS PP 248-E (Griffitts and Olson, 1952), packet 1 (plates 25-26 and pages 3-29): Part 7, Hartwell district (Hart and Elbert Counties, Ga.; Anderson and Abbeville Counties, S.C.). Rock units and pegmatites recorded for the district as a whole, since the text does not separate the states. Individual mica mines and prospects (location list, mine maps and workings, production) are not recorded, as mines and their workings do not fit the schema; plate map faces not itemized. SUBSURFACE: none.
PP 248-E packet 2 (pages 30-40): end of Part 7 and Part 8, outlying mica deposits in South Carolina (Cherokee, Spartanburg, Greenville, Pickens, Oconee and Anderson Counties). Country rocks, granitic sills and pegmatites recorded; individual mines and prospects (e.g. Troy Blanton, Willimon, Cliff Webb) and the vermiculite occurrences are not recorded. SUBSURFACE: none.
